note: Rawbank's standard tariff (updated 15 January 2026, before VAT, whose rate it doesn't state): its Mastercard Standard credit card costs 49 dollars a year; its cards page calls the Mastercard a deferred-debit card, whose spending is settled in full, so nothing is carried on it.

sources.title: Rawbank, Tarification standard T1 2026 (updated 15 January 2026)
sources.said: TARIFICATION STANDARD T1 - 2026 (MAJ DU 15 JANVIER 2026) (HTVA) ... Cartes de Crédit Mastercard ... Standard ... Frais annuel de la carte 49 USD 100 USD 175 USD 100 USD 100 USD

sources.title: Rawbank, Cartes
sources.said: La Mastercard est une carte de crédit (débit différé) vous permettant d’effectuer vos retraits des fonds, vos paiements et vos avances des fonds en toute sécurité.
